verdict.rationale: Weave's tracing docs explicitly document first-party instrumentation in both languages: decorating functions with `@weave.op()` in Python or wrapping them with `weave.op()` in TypeScript, which captures code, inputs, outputs and execution metadata. The GitHub repo corroborates `weave.op` tracing and manual instrumentation of LLM calls and arbitrary functions. missing for 10: evidence on the TypeScript SDK's depth and parity (auto-integrations, agent helpers and cost tracking appear Python-centric), JS/TS install and setup docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the JS/TS SDK.
